# Which good is ticked. The ticked rows come back as the goods themselves, so
# this is a chain over the catalogue rather than over row ordinals.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_read_good = {
	cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__good field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_good_ticks }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 0 }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_good_ticks
		if = { limit = { this = goods:beer } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:books } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 2 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:cannons } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:clay } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 4 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:cloth } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 5 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:coal } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 6 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:cotton } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 7 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:dyes } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 8 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:fiber_crops } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 9 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:fine_cloth } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 10 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:firearms } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 11 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:fish } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 12 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:fruit } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 13 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:furniture } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 14 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:glass } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 15 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:horses } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 16 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:incense } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 17 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:iron } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 18 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:ivory } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 19 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:jewelry } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 20 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:lacquerware } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 21 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:leather } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 22 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:liquor } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 23 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:livestock } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 24 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:lumber } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 25 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:masonry } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 26 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:medicaments } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 27 } } }

		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:paper } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 29 } } }

		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:pottery } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 31 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:salt } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 32 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:saltpeter } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 33 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = goods:sand } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 34 } } }

# Fill the recipe list for whichever good is ticked: each row's label points at
# the key for one (building, method) pair, and each row remembers which method
# that is. Rows the good does not reach are hidden rather than left showing the
# previous good's.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_fill_recipes = {
	switch = {
		trigger = var:bag_wtp_good_index
		1 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_1 = yes }
		2 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_2 = yes }
		3 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_3 = yes }
		4 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_4 = yes }
		5 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_5 = yes }
		6 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_6 = yes }
		7 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_7 = yes }
		8 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_8 = yes }
		9 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_9 = yes }
		10 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_10 = yes }
		11 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_11 = yes }
		12 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_12 = yes }
		13 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_13 = yes }
		14 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_14 = yes }
		15 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_15 = yes }
		16 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_16 = yes }
		17 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_17 = yes }
		18 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_18 = yes }
		19 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_19 = yes }
		20 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_20 = yes }
		21 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_21 = yes }
		22 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_22 = yes }
		23 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_23 = yes }
		24 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_24 = yes }
		25 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_25 = yes }
		26 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_26 = yes }
		27 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_27 = yes }
		28 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_28 = yes }
		29 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_29 = yes }
		30 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_30 = yes }
		31 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_31 = yes }
		32 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_32 = yes }
		33 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_33 = yes }
		34 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_34 = yes }
		35 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_35 = yes }
		36 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_36 = yes }
		37 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_37 = yes }
		38 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_38 = yes }
		39 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_39 = yes }
		40 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_40 = yes }
		41 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_41 = yes }
		42 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_42 = yes }
		43 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_43 = yes }
		44 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_44 = yes }
		45 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_45 = yes }
		46 = { bag_wtp_fill_recipes_46 = yes }

# beer: 17 way(s) to make it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_fill_recipes_1 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_count value = 17 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__recipe_i1_name value = flag:bag_wtp_recipe_4 }

# Which recipe row is ticked, and therefore which method. The rows carry fixed
# flags, so this is twenty branches rather than one per method.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_read_recipe = {
	cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__recipe field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_recipe_ticks }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_recipe_ticks
		if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_1 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_1 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_2 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_2 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 2 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_3 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_3 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_4 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_4 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 4 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_5 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_5 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 5 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_6 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_6 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 6 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_7 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_7 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 7 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_8 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_8 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 8 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_9 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_9 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 9 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_10 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_10 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 10 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_11 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_11 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 11 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_12 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_12 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 12 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_13 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_13 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 13 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_14 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_14 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 14 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_15 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_15 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 15 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_16 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_16 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 16 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_17 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_17 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 17 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_18 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_18 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 18 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { this = flag:bag_wtp_row_19 } root = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_method_index value = global_var:bag_wtp_row_method_19 } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_recipe_row value = 19 } } }

	}

		limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 2 } }
		cmm_set_list_data_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = good field_id = pick item = 2 value = 0 }
